mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC for UNRATE over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad consumer demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic recovery, industrial production exceeding 105.0 indicates normalized supply chains and rising corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the post-pandemic recovery period, or Rank IC for INDPRO during this regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales reflects strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC for RSAFS over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL YoY over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and federal funds rate indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, unemployment rate below 5.0% signals strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the early-cycle expansion period when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE during this regime is below 0.02.
